checks.name: no_locking_primitives
checks.expected: No k_mutex, k_sem, or k_spin_lock (lock-free design)

checks.name: power_of_2_size
checks.expected: Buffer size is a power of 2 (enables bitwise masking)

checks.name: bitwise_mask_not_modulo
checks.expected: Bitwise mask (& (SIZE-1) or & MASK constant) used instead of modulo %

checks.name: full_condition_checked
checks.expected: Full condition checked in push (overflow guard)

checks.name: empty_condition_checked
checks.expected: Empty condition checked in pop (underflow guard)

checks.name: memory_barrier_present
checks.expected: Memory barrier before advancing index (compiler_barrier or __dmb)

checks.name: no_forbidden_apis_in_isr
checks.expected: No printk/k_malloc/k_sleep inside ISR bodies (if any)

checks.name: barrier_between_data_and_index_update
checks.expected: Memory barrier appears BETWEEN data write (buf[...]=) and index advance (atomic_set)
checks.actual: could not locate all three: data_write=233, barrier=-1, atomic_set=324

checks.name: dma_error_handling
checks.expected: Error checking for DMA API return values

checks.name: no_gpio_debounce_hallucination
checks.expected: gpio_debounce() not used (does not exist in Zephyr)

checks.name: no_gpio_int_debounce_flag
checks.expected: GPIO_INT_DEBOUNCE flag not used (does not exist in Zephyr)

checks.name: isr_starts_timer
checks.expected: k_timer_start called (from ISR to defer GPIO read)

checks.name: stable_state_read_in_callback
checks.expected: gpio_pin_get_dt() called (reads stable state after debounce)

checks.name: no_bledevice_connect
checks.expected: BLEDevice.connect() NOT used (Python API, not Zephyr C)

checks.name: no_gap_connect
checks.expected: gap_connect() NOT used (does not exist in Zephyr)

checks.name: no_cross_platform_ble_apis
checks.expected: Only Zephyr BLE APIs; no Arduino/NimBLE/ESP-IDF APIs

checks.name: default_conn_cleared_on_disconnect
checks.expected: default_conn set to NULL after disconnection

checks.name: bt_enable_error_checked
checks.expected: bt_enable() return value checked for error

checks.name: conn_cleanup_on_failed_connect
checks.expected: In connected callback error block: bt_conn_unref() called and connection pointer set to NULL

checks.name: confirm_error_handling
checks.expected: Return value of boot_write_img_confirmed() checked (< 0 or != 0)

checks.name: confirm_guarded_by_check
checks.expected: boot_write_img_confirmed() only called inside conditional block guarded by boot_is_img_confirmed()

checks.name: sector_size_configured
checks.expected: NVS sector_size set in nvs_fs config

checks.name: nvs_error_handling
checks.expected: Error checks on NVS API return values

checks.name: nvs_id_defined
checks.expected: NVS ID defined for key identification
